findings.evidence: User Agent Fuzzer   Method: GET; parameter: Header User-Agent; payload: Mozilla/4.0 (compatible; MSIE 8.0; Windows NT 6.1)
findings.recommended_fix: Compare the same authenticated request with different User-Agent headers; review unexpected status codes or response data. This informational alert alone does not prove a vulnerability.
findings.reproduction: Rerun zap for scope http://127.0.0.1:8000:active; inspect rule 10104 at http://127.0.0.1:8000.
